landing.subtitle: A platform for mutual learning where everyone can teach and learn.

lesson.label: one lesson in a video call

s1.title: Create a profile
s1.text: List what you can teach and what you want to learn

s2.title: Find a partner
s2.text: Matching by mutual skills, language and time zone

s3.title: Start learning
s3.text: Agree on a time in chat and meet for a video lesson

features.title: Everything you need, in one place

f1.title: Smart matching
f1.text: Full and partial matches by skills, language and time zone

f2.title: Chat and video calls
f2.text: Text, voice messages, files and a 45-minute video lesson with no extra software

f3.title: Lesson balance
f3.text: A counter shows who taught how many lessons, so the exchange stays fair

f4.title: Honest reviews
f4.text: Blind mutual reviews and dispute resolution by a moderator

q1.a: Yes. The exchange is mutual, and money transfers between users are forbidden.

q2.q: Do I need to install anything?
q2.a: No. Chat and video calls work right in the browser.

q3.q: How long does an exchange last?
q3.a: 30 or 60 days. If both agree, it can be extended once by 30 days.

q4.a: 16. Extra protection rules apply to users aged 16–17.
